 22740000.

The portion of the BODY containing this data would then look like this (assuming the
 Data Units is coded as ones):

01-44000, PWF, PHO, BCT, 221, 67490000, 0, 0, 0, Rhode Island01-44001, PWF, PHO, BCT,
 65, 20500000, 0, 0, 0, Bristol01-44003, PWF, PHO, BCT, 72, 24250000, 0, 0, 0,

t - For countries other than the United States and Canada, Subarea Name is the
 eleventh field in the body of the file; field 10 is an unused placeholder.

Note:
 

No premium or average deductible values are included in this sample. Zeros are used
 as placeholders when this information is not available.
